tools.name: mri_list_categories
tools.description: List every Machine Relations Index category (e.g. cybersecurity, fintech, enterprise-software, ai-visibility-geo) with the question shapes that have published citation rates, plus the source-role vocabulary. Call this first to get a valid category key.

tools.name: mri_get_category
tools.description: Return one category's question shapes (best tools, how buyers choose, comparisons, top lists, problem-first research, is it worth it, news) and the evidence state of each: published with rates, collecting, or not collectable.

tools.name: mri_get_cited_sources
tools.description: Ranked source domains that AI answer engines cite, pooled across engines, for one category and question shape, with citation rate (share of monitored answer runs citing the domain), rank, percentile and source role (editorial publication, vendor-owned, analyst research, community, academic/governmen

tools.name: mri_get_domain
tools.description: For one domain or URL, return how often AI answer engines cite it: overall citation rate, the rate on each engine (overall.byEngine: cited runs, that engine's observed runs, and whether the engine's sample clears the evidence floor), confidence tier, rank among all cited domains and within its sourc

tools.name: mri_list_engines
tools.description: List each answer engine with the model the release roster names, the engine's observed runs and days, whether that sample clears the evidence floor, and the most-cited source on that engine across the whole window.

tools.name: mri_get_engine
tools.description: Ranked sources one answer engine cites, by that engine's citation rate across the whole window; an engine whose collection changed inside the window also returns collectionRegime, its sources since the change, which is what it cites now. Pass category to limit the list to sources with a published se

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mri_get_domain · Private data: mri_get_cited_sources · Public sink: mri_get_cited_sources, mri_get_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mri_get_domain · Private data: mri_get_cited_sources · Public sink: mri_get_cited_sources, mri_get_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
